messages:
alex_k: Heads up — CI went red on my branch feature-textgen after I rebased onto main. Locally all tests pass. Failing job: linux-py39-unit (see ci link).
ci-bot: Build failed: linux-py39-unit on feature-textgen #7421\nFailed tests: tests/test_generate_serialization.py::test_roundtrip\nLog: https://ci.internal/red/7421\nArtifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/7421/diff/golden-outputs.zip
maria_r: Can you paste the failing assertion or a small snippet from the log?
alex_k: It's an assertion that output.json doesn't match expected golden. The diff was tiny — float precision in preds? snippet:\n```\nAssertionError: assert '"score": 0.123456' == '"score": 0.123455'\n```\n(rounded display from JSON diff)
jamal: Did you re-run CI? sometimes flakes. @ci-bot please rerun the job.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by jamal — queued job #7422
sophie: If it's float rounding, could be a dependency change after the rebase (we bumped numpy/protobuf on main). Can you run the test locally with main's pinned deps? e.g. `pip install -r requirements-main.txt` and `pytest tests/test_generate_serialization.py::test_roundtrip -q`
alex_k: Good call — running with main's lock now. One sec...
alex_k: Repro on my laptop with main deps: same assertion. Looks like behavior changed, not a flaky transient.
maria_r: Any recent commits in main touching serialization or model proto? I recall a proto bump in the infra PRs.
jamal: There was a protobuf bump two commits ago: `chore: bump protobuf 3.20.0 -> 4.25.0` — flagged in release notes. That could change textproto/float formatting. Might be the cause, worth bisecting.
alex_k: I can bisect tomorrow if no one beats me to it. Quick workaround would be to pin protobuf back to 3.20 in the branch but that may mask other fixes.
sophie: Short-term unblock: make the test tolerant for float comparison (use approx with small rel/abs tol) and add a TODO to revert when infra is settled. I can prepare a tiny PR for the test change and mark INFRA ticket.
alex_k: :thumbsup: Please. If you add tolerant compare, mark it with TODO and link INFRA-312.
maria_r: Also add an infra changelog note about the protobuf bump so other teams see potential golden diffs.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: job #7422 — result: failed (tests/test_generate_serialization.py::test_roundtrip) — flaky: false
jamal: Ok not a flake. Assigning bisect to alex_k. @alex_k set bisect range from last known good on main (before the proto bump) to tip and report the first bad commit.
alex_k: On it — will run `git bisect` using the two commits and report earliest bad commit. ETA this afternoon.
sophie: I'll open INFRA-312 to track protobuf impact, the tolerant-test quick-fix, and follow-up to decide whether to pin or adapt codegen.
alex_k: Thanks all — will post bisect results and link PR for the test fix once ready.
